events.title: Carrier Global Q1 Earnings Beat Estimates, Revenue Up Year over Year
events.body: CARR tops Q1 estimates as data center-driven HVAC demand lifts orders, though margins shrink and organic sales dip.

events.title: Carrier Global (CARR) Is Up 9.1% After Q1 Beat Driven By Surging Data Center Orders
events.body: Carrier Global Corporation has released its Q1 2026 results, reporting revenue of US$5,341 million with lower net income of US$238 million, while reaffirming full-year sales and adjusted EPS guidance amid tariff and macroeconomic pressures.
